Build the reference tables

Source: R/reference.R
jn_update_reference.Rd

Rebuilds journals, journal_issns, agreements, agreement_journals, agreement_institutions and portfolios from the raw Journal Checker Tool (JCT) and ESAC files in raw_dir, validates them against jn_schema() and checks that every issn_l and agreement_id resolves.

Usage

jn_update_reference(raw_dir = "data-raw", quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

raw_dir

Directory with the raw files.

quiet

If FALSE, report coverage diagnostics.

Value

A named list of six tibbles, plus a diagnostics element listing journal-list rows without ISSN-L and institutions without ROR ID.

Details

Expected files in raw_dir (see data-raw/README.md):

  • jct_jn_all.csv.gz, esac_df.csv: current JCT journal lists and the ESAC registry.

  • jct_inst_all.csv, legacy/jct_institutions.csv: participating institutions per agreement, current and from hoaddata 0.3.

  • legacy/jct_hybrid_jns.csv.gz: JCT lists used by hoaddata 0.3, kept so that journals and agreements no longer listed in the JCT stay in.

  • openalex_sources.csv: OpenAlex journals with ISSNs and open access status, written by jn_fetch_openalex_sources(). ISSN-Ls, titles, OpenAlex IDs and oa_model come from here; ISSNs that OpenAlex does not know fall back to the legacy file.

  • legacy/journal_titles.csv: fallback journal titles.

  • manual/*.csv: curated lookups (publisher names, OA models, publishers that flipped their journals to open access, exclusions, portfolios) and corrections of the JCT institution lists (manual/institution_corrections.csv: participating institutions to add to or remove from an agreement, with the source). A correction that no longer applies, because the JCT has changed, stops the build.
